measure: The analysis pipeline, wired by hand, with the code metrics: RepositoryValidator, the selected roots in MAIN, GENERATED, TEST order, a fresh cache, one RUNNING analysis, then SpoonModelBuilder.analyze with a StructureExtractor over an ElementWriter that a delegating sink only times; every number is SQL over the rows read back after end(), against benchmarks/dependency-extraction.json for the same repository and selection. The LOC and CC times are StructureExtractor.metricTime(); the FILE loc, which the pre-parse computes outside that timer, is recounted after the analysis, outside every clock and the heap meter, over the same bytes. commons-lang ALL is measured a second time at the end and its two code_metric dumps compared byte for byte.

selections.DEFAULT: MAIN and GENERATED, no TEST: the analysis default and spoon-corpus.json's population

environment.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
environment.runtime: full JDK under Maven Surefire, not the jlink image the application ships
